access.deniedHint: Item lists are part of Analytics. Ask an administrator for the Analytics grant (uploading needs the author grant).
access.unreachableHint: Your permissions could not be read. Reload the page to try again.

upload.title: Upload an item list
upload.subtitle: Items or item groups, each with the periods your team states — shared with the people you choose, for Copilot to analyse on.
upload.reuploadSubtitle: The file replaces the list's contents as a new version, after the same preview. Its name and audience stay.
upload.notOwner: Only the list's owner can upload a new version of it.
upload.loadFailed: The list could not be read.

template.title: Start from the template
template.hint: Columns Level, Key, From, To, Status and Note, with English and Arabic headers and the allowed statuses.
template.failed: The template could not be downloaded.

drop.title: Choose the file
drop.hint: An .xlsx or a .csv of at most 2 MB. Nothing is kept until you save.
drop.failed: The file could not be read.

preview.title: Preview
preview.lede: Checked against the item master. Only the matched rows are saved; the unknown values are listed on the list.
preview.keptUntil: This preview is kept until <at>{{at}}</at>. Save before then.
preview.noneMatched: Nothing in the file matched an item or a group, so there is nothing to save. Fix the file and choose it again.

kindHints.unknown: Matched nothing in analytics. They are not members; the list keeps them for display.
kindHints.duplicate: The same row more than once.
kindHints.badDate: Not a date: use an Excel date cell or yyyy-mm-dd.
kindHints.overlap: Two periods of one member overlap. Fix the dates so they follow each other.
kindHints.refused: Refused by the server, for the reason given.

expired.title: The preview expired
expired.body: A preview is kept for 30 minutes. Choose the file again to see it and save.

save.title: Name and share
save.name: Name
save.nameHint: How your team and Copilot will call it, for example Shortage Q3.
save.saved: The list is saved and shared.
save.failed: The list could not be saved.

hold.expired: The preview expired: choose the file again.
hold.nothingMatched: Nothing matched, so there is nothing to save.
hold.noAudience: Choose at least one role or person, or share with everyone.

list.title: Item list
list.subtitle: Items and groups with the availability periods the team states. Copilot reads them as the team's statement, not as stock data.
list.failed: The list could not be read.
list.exportFailed: The list could not be exported.
list.noPeriods: No periods: the members are just members.
list.noUnknown: Every value in the last file matched.
